intentions.title: Give every Team one dashboard of all their Barkparks, regardless of who provisioned or hosts them
intentions.evidence: barkpark.ex: Barkpark row is the metadata unifying managed/byo/self_hosted instances under one Team-scoped model, with separate health_status/agent_status/suspended axes so the dashboard never conflates 'unreachable' with 'billing lapsed' or 'agent down'.

intentions.title: Make provider-neutral hosting real: Hetzner and Azure are interchangeable backends behind one provisioning contract
intentions.evidence: barkpark.ex `provider` field (hetzner|azure) plus region/server_type; hetzner_catalog.ex `normalize/2` and azure_catalog.ex both emit the identical %{regions, server_types, currency} shape (charter Decision 9) so the UI/CLI never special-case a provider.

intentions.title: Go-live in under 15 seconds via a crash-safe warm pool of pre-baked, self-refreshing boxes
intentions.evidence: warm_server.ex: ready/claimed/retiring/refreshing states claimed via `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` to avoid the old fixed-name 'warm-1' collision bug; refreshing boxes rejoin `ready` on completion so idle pool boxes never drift from origin/main.

intentions.title: Drive the create-to-live provisioning chain (and deprovision/attach-domain/resurrect) through one auditable, retry-bounded job queue shared by the Elixir control plane and the Go worker
intentions.evidence: provision_job.ex: flat pending→claimed→succeeded/failed state machine with claim_token/attempts/stale re-claim, one-active-job-per-(barkpark,kind) unique index (dwb-11 money-path backstop), and append-only steps/console fields (dwb-14/dwb-16) that let /new render honest server-confirmed progress.

intentions.title: Ship Barkpark-hosted website deployments (gh: build, push, promote, branch previews) with the same claim-fencing discipline as instance provisioning
intentions.evidence: deployment.ex: queued→building→pushing→live/failed transition graph enforced via `legal_transition?/2`, claim_worker/claim_epoch CAS fencing mirroring bp task claims, environment=production|preview split (gh-6) so branch previews never touch the production live pointer, and promote-by-new-deployment (never a pointer flip, charter decision 7).

intentions.title: Never let a cloud-provider action reach a customer's account outside an explicit, tiered allowlist
intentions.evidence: hetzner_catalog.ex: `fetch/2` is an exact (resource, verb) lookup against a pure static catalog — no prefix matching, no free-form passthrough; :read served now, :mutate/:destroy declared but unrouted, every destroy entry demands a server-verified typed-name `confirm` echo before executing (charter decision 5).

intentions.title: Encrypt every credential and secret at rest behind one Vault seam, and never let a narrow write path widen into identity or team reassignment
intentions.evidence: provider.ex: `encrypted_token` is the single ciphertext column for both hetzner tokens and azure service-principal JSON, validated pre-encryption via a virtual `:credential` field; barkpark.ex has 8+ narrow changesets (health_changeset, suspend_changeset, vercel_changeset, custom_host_changeset, autoupdate_changeset, etc.) each explicitly scoped to prevent an agent/worker/billing write from renaming or re-teaming an instance.

intentions.title: Keep an append-only, honest audit trail of everything an on-box agent (and the control plane's own verification) reports about an instance
intentions.evidence: agent_event.ex: jsonb payload per typed event (health/status/backup/tls/content/verify), inserted_at only (no updated_at) — a fact at a point in time, never mutated; `verify` events let the control plane re-issue and timeline a golden-path readiness proof independent of on-box coupling (D16).
